Package com.composum.sling.platform.staging

Interface ReleaseChangeEventListener

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    AbstractReplicationService, InPlacePublisherService
    public interface ReleaseChangeEventListener

    A service that receives activation events and can publish these - e.g. to /publish and /preview in the JCR or even remote servers. There can be an arbitrary number of ReleaseChangeEventListeners, which decide based on the ReleaseChangeEvents they receive whether they have to do something.

    The transmitted resources can be "mix:versionable"s, hierarchy nodes containing several "mix:versionable"s or none (e.g. assets). The ReleaseChangeEventListener has to check that on his own, if that's relevant. Usually it will be Resources from a StagingResourceResolver for the given release.

    It's the ReleaseChangeEventListener's job to decide what actions to take on that. It can assume that it receives all ReleaseChangeEvents or that the user is informed about an error (or, at least, did not get an acknowledgement of success) and that it is the users responsibility to trigger a full site update to fix any errors due to missing events.

    For a ReleaseChangeEventListener it is advisable to check whether resources referred by the activated / updated resources are updated, too, since e.g. for assets and configurations there might not be any activation events. Also the order of children in the parent nodes of a resource might have changed.

    • Method Detail

      • receive

        default void receive​(ReleaseChangeEvent releaseChangeEvent)
              throws ReleaseChangeFailedException
        This informs the replication service about an activation / deactivation / update. The publisher can decide on his own whether he is responsible. The processing should be synchronous, so that the user can be notified whether it succeeded or not. CAUTION: the changes can also encompass the attributes and node order of parent nodes of the resources transmitted in the event.
        Throws:
        ReleaseChangeFailedException

      • processesFor

        @NotNull
default @NotNull Collection<? extends ReleaseChangeProcess> processesFor​(@NotNull
                                                                         @NotNull Release release)
        Collection of ReleaseChangeProcesses that should be run in background upon receiving events for the release. This is usually an alternative to receive(ReleaseChangeEvent) for things that can take more time than a request should take. If this returns some processes, they are ReleaseChangeProcess.triggerProcessing(ReleaseChangeEvent) with the events and then ReleaseChangeProcess#run().
